nodes.name: Send Notification (replace with Slack/Email/SMS node)
nodes.notes: MANUAL SETUP REQUIRED: replace this No-Op node with a Slack, Email, or Telegram node configured with your own credentials. This placeholder exists so the workflow imports cleanly without requiring pre-configured secrets.

meta.instructions: Import into n8n, then copy this workflow's Webhook node Production URL into the backend's N8N_OUTBOUND_WEBHOOK_URL env var. Replace the final No-Op node with a real notification node (Slack/Email/etc.) using your own n8n credentials.
